utResolvedDecision.bindingProductRule: Stop searching for an undefined trafficking-specific 1231XX form. Use the Post-Conviction Remedies Act ground in Utah Code Section 78B-9-104(1)(h) and the court's Rule 65C PCRA petition in the district court where the conviction was entered. Collect the qualifying offense, trafficking/force/fraud/coercion relationship and supporting evidence, and apply the burden/attachment/service treatment identified in the supplied disposition.
utResolvedDecision.authority: Utah Code Section 78B-9-104(1)(h) and Rule 65C cited in the supplied disposition.
